phase: Phase F1b - second LRO tracking day: time-tag offset or reference-orbit along-track error?
data: trk/lro_no_01/2009285, PAD 103 (Dongara, 35 files) and PAD 129 (Weilheim WU2S, 5 files; WGS-84 47 52 52.3160 N, 11 05 01.0280 E, 663.37 m from lrors_arch_sis Appendix A); same reference SPK lro_no_01_grgm900c_l600.bsp, 25 days after F1's 2009-260
method: F1's M_FULL residuals and F1's per-pass fit bias + dt * rho_dot (phase_f1_slope_diagnostic.py), unchanged except the day directory and the added PAD 129

decision_rule.TIME_TAG_OFFSET: every 2009-285 pass with >= 100 ranges has dt within 1.0 ms of F1's mean -3.21 ms
decision_rule.ORBIT_ALONG_TRACK: the 2009-285 passes share a dt that differs from -3.21 ms by more than 1.0 ms (a time-tag convention cannot change between days; an orbit error can)

also_reported: per-pass mean residual (station delay) for Dongara on both days
